note: AD-038, AD-123 (cobblestone x1.5 with roads.4, stone bricks x2 with roads.6). Tiers follow ROAD-003: prepared dirt, gravel, cobbled, improved paving. speed_bonus multiplies base movement speed of any living user standing on a registered cell; the bonus fades linearly to half at wear 100. samples_per_wear: moving-entity samples (one per 10 ticks) that add one wear point. Light target is block light on the walking layer, independent of daylight. A fenced corridor adds posts on both sides, a gate every gate_spacing cells and a guard post with a lantern every post_spacing cells; guards of the settlement patrol between the village and those posts.
hostile_note: AD-123: hostile mobs (Enemy) get at most the pre-rework best surface bonus, so paving x1.5/x2 speeds residents, players and animals, not zombies. Set to 1.0 to let monsters use the full surface.
